subject: Bracket IPv6 hosts in FT.HYBRID fanout targets (#1621)
reason: The only production change is one line in PerformMultiSearchFanoutAsync (src/query/fanout.cc:754): the gRPC dial target for FT.HYBRID's remote-shard fanout is now built with coordinator::FormatAddressWithPort, which brackets IPv6 hosts. That code runs only when valkey-search's coordinator is active: commands.cc gates fanout on UsingCoordinator() && IsCluster(), and the coordinator exists only when the module is started with the use-coordinator option.
